LESSON: LOCATION AND SIZE OF THE COUNTY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Location and Size of the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Location and Size of the County, part of Natural and Built Environments in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to learn the size and location of a county? 2. How can you determine the location of a county in relation to its neighbours?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Location and Size of the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: learners develop digital technology skills as they use digital devices while playing games on the location of the

county in relation to the neighbouring counties.

● Communication and Collaboration: learners develop teamwork as they contribute in group discussions on the size of the county in

relation to the neighbouring counties.

Values:
● Responsibility: learners develop self-drive as they engage in assigned roles and duties as they discuss in groups the size of the

county in relation to the neighbouring counties

● Integrity: learners exhibit fairness as they play in turns computer games on compass direction for enjoyment

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Decision Making and Problem-Solving: learners play creative games and compete as they locate the county in relation to the

neighbouring counties

● Effective Communication: learners discuss in groups the size of the county in relation to the neighbouring counties.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Creative Arts: learners apply drawing skills learned in creative art to sketch, colour, and display the map of the county in class.

● English, Kenya Sign Language: learners apply discussion skills to discuss in groups the size of the county in relation to the

neighbouring counties
